## Slime zombie Gargoyle (CR 4)

**XP** 1,600  
N Medium plant  
**Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; **Perception** +13  


**Defense**


**AC** 18, touch 11, flat-footed 17 (+1 Dex, +7 natural)  
**hp** 130 (10d8+40 plus 10)  
**Fort** +11; **Ref** +4; **Will** +3  
**DR** 10/—; **Immune** electricity, plant traits  
**Weaknesses** vulnerability to green slime  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** slam +10 (1d6+4)  
**Special Attacks** infestation (DC 19)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 17, **Dex** 12, **Con** 18, **Int** 2, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 1  
**Base Atk** +7; **CMB** +10; **CMD** 21  
**Feats** Hover, Improved Initiative, Skill Focus (Fly)  
**Skills** Perception +13  
**Languages** telepathic bond  
**SQ** death throes, mind link*  


**Special Abilities**


**Death Throes (Ex)** When a slime zombie gargoyle is brought to 0 hit points, its structure collapses and it transforms in a single round as a pool of olive slime.  

**Infestation (Ex)** Any creature hit by the slime zombie gargoyle’s slam attack must succeed on a Fortitude save or be infested with olive slime. This infestation works as described in the olive slime entry. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Telepathic Bond (Su)** Olive slime zombies have a telepathic bond with each other to a range of 100 feet if they were created by the same olive slime. This bond allows them rudimentary communication with one another.  

**Vulnerability vs. Green Slime** A slime zombie is vulnerable to green slime. It takes 2d6 points of damage per round it touches green slime. If brought to 0 hit points, the slime zombie does not transform into a patch of olive slime.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** temperate marshes and underground  
**Organization** solitary, patch (2–5), or colony (6–20)  
**Treasure** none
